data.one_liner: Customisable tab view and carousel widget with an animated indicator
data.what_it_does: Provides a tab view or carousel widget that handles switching between children and tabs with an animated indicator. Supports changing tab placement, custom border radii, and color animation per tab.
use_when: You want a customisable tab view or carousel with an animated indicator
You need tabs positioned on different edges of the container
You want background colors to change dynamically based on the selected tab
avoid_when: You need the standard Material Scaffold and AppBar tab integration without a custom wrapper container
strengths: Supports custom TabController or built-in list management
Automatic scrolling when there are too many tabs
weaknesses: Requires manual disposal of the TabController if you supply one
Limited to the specific layout structure provided by the package

alternatives.name: carousel_slider
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically need a carousel slider component rather than a combined tab view and container.
